title: Automatic gearbox smoothness
summary: Feedback on the F70 automatic gearbox centers on shift smoothness and driving feel, with clear praise for seamless operation but also complaints about rough or inconsistent gear changes and many comments that are too contextual or contradictory to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the automatic gearbox as smooth, seamless, responsive, and well matched to the engine in everyday driving.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize the gearbox for feeling less refined than other BMWs, lacking smoothness, and hesitating or hopping between gears when pulling away.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews combine generally favorable impressions of the car or gearbox with reservations that the automatic does not feel as good or as smooth as expected.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the automatic gearbox or first-time automatic use but do not provide enough clear evaluative context, and some examples appear sentiment-bearing yet remain assigned as undetermined.

limitations: The sampled fragments are stratified and not representative of all reviews on this topic.
Many examples are short or incomplete, which limits confidence about the specific gearbox issue being described.
Some undetermined examples contain evaluative wording, so the assigned labels constrain how precisely they can be summarized.
